title: Laing
description: Laing is a dish from Philippines prepared with garlic, shallot, spinach, coconut milk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Laing-inspired coconut greens, NOT authentic taro-leaf laing: spinach replaces taro leaves; never use improperly prepared taro leaves.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 8 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Simmer the spinach, coconut milk, pork belly and shrimp paste gently until meat is fully cooked. This is a spinach adaptation, NOT a method for raw taro leaves.
Continue simmering the sauce from the previous step uncovered until concentrated and thick enough to coat the ingredients.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
